articles.summary:

The software runs in hundreds of millions of devices, including those used by Palo Alto Networks, Siemens, Honeywell, and Boeing. articles.title: Researchers Exploit OpenAI API Flaw to Extract Hidden GPT-5.6 Reasoning Traces
articles.summary:
Researchers at Xint found an OpenAI API flaw that exposed hidden reasoning in GPT-5.6 models by routing prompts through a conversation-compaction feature. The method, called compaction smuggling, bypassed protections introduced in August 2026. articles.title: Critical HashiCorp Consul Kubernetes Flaw Allows Attackers to Gain Elevated Privileges
articles.summary:
HashiCorp has released fixes for a Consul-k8s authorization bypass that could allow an attacker to gain elevated Consul privileges from another Kubernetes namespace. Tracked as CVE-2026-110720, the flaw affects deployments using automated system access control list management.
